summary: Five audits requested by TDSC reviewers. Label permutation and entity overlap are pass/fail gates; the other three are diagnostic.

checks.pass_criterion: permuted AP within 0.05 of test prevalence
checks.interpretation: If permuted AP stays near prevalence, the learned signal is real, not memorized labels.

checks.pass_criterion: zero shared connected components between train and test
checks.note: Each ccId is one connected component; disjoint ccIds imply no shared nodes or cross-split edges by construction.

checks.interpretation: Shows which pooling group carries the signal; helps rule out a single derived feature dominating the result.

checks.note: If prevalence differs materially between size-based splits, the 30.6% gap is a joint size/label distribution shift, not pure temporal drift.
